errors.text_span: Die linke Skala reicht von -200 bis 400 und die rechte Skala reicht von -100 bis 400
errors.evidence: According to the reference, the left vertical axis ranges from 0 to 400 and the right vertical axis ranges from -200 to 400. The machine-generated description has these reversed.

errors.text_span: Die Exporte werden durch eine durchgezogene blaue Linie dargestellt
errors.evidence: According to the reference, the blue line represents Importe (imports), not Exporte (exports). The red line represents Exporte.

errors.text_span: Die Importe werden durch eine durchgezogene braune Linie dargestellt
errors.evidence: According to the reference, the imports are represented by a blue line and exports by a red line. The machine-generated description calls the import line 'brown' and assigns it to imports, but gets the color wrong (should be blue), while also inverting the export/import mapping.

errors.text_span: die bei 150 Milliarden US-Dollar im ersten Quartal 2020 beginnt

errors.text_span: Der Handelsbilanzsaldo wird durch vertikale, schattierte blaue Balken dargestellt
errors.evidence: According to the reference, the balance (Saldo) is represented by small bars that go downward (negative direction), not described as 'schattierte blaue Balken'. The reference also indicates they run downward (negative values), not ranging from -100 to 200 as stated.

errors.text_span: mit einem maximalen Wert von 190 Milliarden US-Dollar im ersten Quartal 2021
errors.evidence: According to the reference, the Saldo bars run downward (negative values only), starting small and growing longer in the negative direction. A positive maximum value of 190 billion contradicts this.

errors.text_span: mit einem minimalen Wert von -190 Milliarden US-Dollar im zweiten Quartal 2022 und einem maximalen Wert von 190 Milliarden US-Dollar im ersten Quartal 2021
errors.evidence: The reference does not mention these specific values. The Saldo bars are described as going downward and growing larger over time, with no positive maximum value mentioned.
